name: Janeiro's Point
summary: Ships pass Janeiro's Point on their way into Booty Bay. Mok'rash the Cleaver claims the island's shores and waters.

sections.title: Beacon of the Bay
sections.body: Ships bound for Booty Bay pass Janeiro's Point at the harbor's edge in southern Stranglethorn Vale. A colossal stone goblin spreads its arms atop the rocky crag, welcoming vessels to the bay. Sailors can see the statue for miles, yet Mok'rash the Cleaver claims the island. The sea giant makes landing on its shores perilous.

faq.answer: Janeiro's Point is a small, rocky island just outside Booty Bay's harbor in Stranglethorn Vale. Ships bound for the goblin port use it as a landmark.

faq.q: Who is the giant statue on the island?
faq.answer: The colossal statue shows an unknown goblin with arms outstretched. It welcomes trade ships and sailors to Booty Bay.

faq.q: What dangerous creature lives on Janeiro's Point?
faq.answer: Mok'rash the Cleaver, a sea giant, claims Janeiro's Point and its surrounding waters. He endangers mariners and swimmers who approach the statue.
